The raku slot-kind census beside it reads **graded=922 no_layout=7 (declared=2 defect=5), unkinded=0 holes=0** (was 9/graded=918 at `621c08866`; `benchmark_rc-man-or-boy-test` and `benchmark_point_class_add2` gained layouts on the `:=` bind landing). The five defects are rowed elsewhere and are front-end parse refusals, not collector holes — measured, not assumed: every no_layout entry is ALSO red on this board, so the set is a SUBSET of the master's own reds.
